criteria.text: styles.css takes every colour, size, spacing (the touch minimum and the due edge among them), radius and duration from a custom property of tokens.css.
tokens.css holds the approved tokens: each theme's colours as --color-<name> (light on :root, dark under prefers-color-scheme: dark), and the type, space, radius and duration scales.
Every declared text-on-background pair reaches the AA ratio in tokens.css, in both themes.
At 360 px each plant row stacks name and Due label, interval, last watering and a full-width Watered button at least the touch token (48 px) tall.
At 720 px each plant row puts its Watered button, at least 160 px wide and the touch token tall, at the row's right.
At 1280 px each plant row lays out as columns name, interval, last watering and button, in a centred column at most 960 px wide.
Every button and link keeps a visible focus outline (focus token).
The loading pulse and button transitions stop under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
The page marks each state: data-state state-loading, state-ok, state-empty, state-unreachable on the list's root, and data-row-state idle, watering, failed, watered on each row.
The page's logo file is the logo slot's on_dark variant.
android/src/theme/tokens.js holds the approved tokens (both themes' colours, type, space, radius, duration).
Every declared text-on-background pair reaches the AA ratio in android/src/theme/tokens.js, in both themes.
The screen and the simulation mark each state: testID state-loading, state-ok, state-empty, state-unreachable, and each row's idle, watering, failed or watered.
The app's logo file is derived from the logo slot's on_dark variant.
A watering logged on one target shows on the other after a reload, and a plant past its interval is marked Due on both.

human_tests.text: In a browser at 360, 720 and 1280 px: the list matches its mockups; press Watered on a Due plant: the row updates without a reload and the Due label goes; reload: the same. Tab through the page with the keyboard only; press Back: it leaves the page.

On a native Android runtime (pending in this version): the screen matches the simulation in portrait and landscape; no permission prompt appears; Watered and Try again respond to a tap; system Back leaves the app; a watering logged here shows on the web page after a reload, and the reverse.
